title: Havana Enclave
address:
315 NW 27th Ave
Miami, Florida 33125
United States
description:
Havana Enclave is an eight-story residential building in Miami's Little Havana neighborhood, with 179 units in studio, one-bedroom, and two-bedroom layouts.

Residents have a pool, a barbecue area, a fitness center, a business center, a meeting room, a pet washing station, a children's playroom and game room, and electric vehicle charging stations.
